jobs.prompt: Premium textured gouache children’s editorial illustration, landscape 3:2. A potted bean plant has four clearly visual cues: a small watering can for water, gentle air movement lines, warm sun rays, and visible healthy soil around roots. Amina, a 6–7 year-old Northern Nigerian primary learner from the AJAMIX recurring-character guide, gently checks the soil without touching leaves or stem. Warm storybook composition, clean silhouettes, controlled focal hierarchy, classroom sill or courtyard context, upper-left and lower-right quiet label-safe space. No text in artwork; labels will be composited later.
jobs.negativePrompt: No words, letters, numbers, watermark, logo, branding, photorealism, glossy 3D render, flat generic vector art, busy background, decorative tribal motifs, exaggerated facial features, unsafe child behavior, distorted hands, broken plant, or label/callout graphics.
jobs.safetyNote: Do not depict a child pulling a leaf or breaking the stem, and do not show excessive water being poured.
